'''Foerost''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbited by the famous [[Foerost Shipyards]], which was one of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] largest and oldest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]].

==Description==
Foerost was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TSW" /> in the [[Foerost system/Legends|Foerost system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was located along the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]], between [[Kuar]] and [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].<ref name="TEA" />

Although a city, [[Hajibar]], existed on Foerost at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="HNN53" /> the planet was uninhabited during most of its history. The planet was renowned for its [[Foerost Shipyards|shipyards]], located in high [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The shipyards' engineers removed raw materials from the planet and transported them to the shipyards. The shipyards of Foerost were among the oldest and most successful large-scale construction facilities in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TSW" />

==History==
The planet was originally a vassal colony of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]], but had achieved full [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] membership by [[11,000 BBY]].<ref name="Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref> During the [[Tionese War]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was headquartered at Foerost, the site of the Republic's largest [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The Foerost Shipyards were engulfed by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] fleet during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TEA" /> Centuries later, in [[3996 BBY]], during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a combined [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]/[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] fleet [[Battle of Foerost (Great Sith War)|captured]] 300 [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] warships from the shipyards for use in an [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|assault]] on the Republic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Decades later, in [[3959 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|stole]] a major Republic fleet from the shipyards, triggering the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Millennia later, the shipyards were purchased from the Republic by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].<ref name="HNN53" /> During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], the Techno Union secretly joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] with the objective to overthrow the Republic. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted, the Techno Union provided the Foerost Shipyards to the Separatist war effort. In response, the Republic [[Foerost Siege|blockaded]] Foerost, expecting the shipyards to decline without access to Separatist supply line. Contrariwise, Separatist engineers were able to develop and secretly build a fleet of [[Bulwark Mark I|''Bulwark''-class battleships]]. After nearly two years of blockade, the [[Bulwark Fleet]] was revealed when it [[Battle of Foerost (Clone Wars)|broke]] the siege of Foerost. This fleet ravaged [[Imperial Center Oversector|Sector Zero]] until it was stopped by a fleet of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[Victory Fleet]].<ref name="TNEC" /> After the defeat of the Bulwark Fleet at the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]], the Republic eventually recaptured Foerost.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|284|Foerost}}</ref>
